units.source_text: 阿繁把门票掖在腰带里。

en.t: A繁 tucked the admission ticket into her sash.

units.source_text: 开阔的景致使她的心情豁然开朗。

en.t: The wide open view suddenly brightened her spirits.

units.source_text: 在批发商店街看见的山，也仅仅是其中一角。

en.t: The mountains she had seen from the wholesale shop street were only one small part of it.

units.source_text: 何况阿繁很少出店铺到马路上走走呢。

en.t: Besides, A繁 rarely left the shop to take a walk along the road.
